entries.title: Psalms 143:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, [and] in thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:2
segments: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 143:3
segments: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

entries.title: Psalms 143:4
segments: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.

entries.title: Psalms 143:5
segments: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.

entries.title: Psalms 143:6
segments: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul [thirsteth] after thee, as a weary land. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 143:7
segments: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.

entries.title: Psalms 143:8
segments: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 143:9
segments: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

entries.title: Psalms 143:10
segments: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:11
segments: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 143:12
segments: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.
